svg.title: When do I commit? Commits by weekday and hour
svg.desc: 533 commits appear as dots on a grid of weekdays and hours. Bars count them per hour and per weekday. The peak hour is 15:00. At the end a snake eats every dot and the score counts to 533.

g.text: one dot = one commit · Europe/Berlin time
